hypothesis: Profitability may distinguish cheap viable companies from cheap weak businesses; retaining eligible near-cutoff holdings and tolerating small weight drift may reduce turnover costs while sacrificing some signal precision.
period: All quarter-end snapshots March 2018 through December 2025, retaining insufficient and invalid dates explicitly; no exits or returns computed.

features.value: positive parent book equity / previously prepared disclosed-capital price proxy
features.profitability: annual parent earnings / positive end-of-year parent book equity; closing-equity ROE proxy, not operating profitability or average-equity ROE
features.negative_earnings: retained and ranked, not imputed or filtered
features.source_checks: Exact CNPJ, ref_date, version, document_id, receipt+1 calendar day, archive hashes and annual duration 330-400 days. Verify both source numerators against prepared H18/H19 ratios. Retain inherited 550-day staleness limit and universe gates; not a complete original-publication audit.
features.score: Descending average ranks (midranks for exact ties) of value and profitability, equally weighted; final tie by ticker. No fitted weights, clipping, winsorization or sector exclusion.

selection.buffer: Keep at most target_count actual incumbent ticker+ISIN pairs in best ceil(0.30*N), strongest first; fill vacant slots by score. Exits for absent/ineligible identity remain mandatory.
selection.universe: Identical valid joint value/profitability universe across all three arms; missing source/zero or negative equity remains explicit excluded, never zero.

orders.weight_band: 0.025 of supplied signal-date sizing capital, absolute target/current notional difference; same positive selected holdings only; exits and new names never suppressed. Reject identity/date gaps even for suppressed trades.
orders.causality: Freeze targets and current holdings at signal; reject stale book before execution and unchecked corporate boundary. Existing RetailBook handles standard/fractional orders, funding, settlements and fiscal basis.
orders.interpretation: Rank and weight bands are uncalibrated implementation choices, not forecasts that a trade will or will not pay its full tax cost. No claimed optimality.

diagnostics: per-arm planned membership changes (not executed turnover)
entry-only integer execution on available primary quotes for every eligible arm/date/capital/cost
synthetic paired-book costs, funding, risk drift and forced exits
evidence_boundary: Existing H19 evidence does not certify new holdings or retention intervals. Full historical net profit stays null; never feed H20 plans into the frozen H19 contract or set its coverage gate true.
stopping_rule: One frozen set of three arms and two bands. No return scan or parameter rescue. Source gaps block cases without filling defaults. Run mechanical and input diagnostics, report all arms; further net-return evaluation requires a new protocol covering new intervals and independent/prospective validation.
acceptance: Mechanically causal deterministic scores; equal comparison universe; mandatory exits; fewer trades in independently computed synthetic marginal-adjustment case; no negative funded cash; old H19 replay unchanged. Historical cost/coverage figures may be favorable or unfavorable and do not determine parameter changes.
